# SettingsProfile

Which settings screen a [MainMenu](MainMenu.md)'s `"settings"` item builds.

## Values

- `full`: The complete Video / Audio / Controls settings, with the graphics quality preset and the Quality / Advanced render-feature groups.
- `minimal`: A trimmed Video tab (window mode, resolution, vsync, frame rate) and an Audio tab (volume) only: no Controls tab, no graphics quality preset, and no scene-render groups. Suits a world that renders no 3D scene.
